svg.title: AFIFO block diagram
svg.desc: Write control in the wr_clk domain and read control in the rd_clk domain. Two GrayPointers and the TwoClockRegFile straddle the clock-domain boundary. push_data goes into the register file on wr_clk, and pop_data comes out of it on rd_clk. Each GrayPointer carries one pointer to the other domain.
svg.text: Blocks on the dashed line have ports in both domains. Blue: data. Orange: pointers. Gray: control and status.
a_* on wr_clk · b_* on rd_clk
Dashed arrows: ports that inclAlmostFull and inclAlmostEmpty add. GrayPointer and TwoClockRegFile have their own specs.
